Real-candidate read-only fresh-process review: 12 frozen inputs and 2 sealed outputs verified; full runtime preflight passed without claiming the operation or writing candidate/profile/database. Current and frozen producers yield identical 548 dates and 71053 coefficient values; metadata path/authority changes alone caused the collision.
root_cause: DERIVE checkpoint lookup required the current default producer digest even though the completed operation had frozen its producer/model/config inputs. A reviewed producer-only authority rebind therefore invalidated a sealed derivation and attempted to overwrite immutable coefficient output. DERIVE artifact validation also returned false on corruption, which could request regeneration instead of preserving and rejecting the sealed output.
